name: jev
title: jev · typed questions over the Jev model, paid in crypto
description: Complete wrapper over jevgo, the Go client for TypeSafe AI's System One API and its Jev model (github.com/fgn/jevgo), served over the mod protocol. One static Go bridge binary does every call — client options, retries, headers, logging, tracing, error sentinels — and mod.py is a thin shell onto it: ask typed questions (noul yes/no, choice, score, raw) about any state and get probability distributions back. Anyone can ask over HTTP or MCP and pay per question in USDC with no account and no KYC: x402 (HTTP 402, sign an EIP-3009 transfer, retry) or prepaid credits under a mod-protocol wallet token. The operator's TypeSafe key stays in the environment; the facilitator settles; the owner's address receives.

env.TYPESAFE_API_KEY: required for answers — System One API key (secret, env only)
env.TYPESAFE_LOG_LEVEL: optional — debug|info|warn|error|off, jevgo's own slog output

pay.note: public defaults; pay_to and overrides live in ~/.mod/jev/pay.json (m jev/pricing pay_to=0x…)

app.docs: GET /jev/ -> the console (web/index.html): ask, pay per call with a browser wallet, credits

health.docs: liveness, whether the bridge is built and payment is on

info.docs: what the jevgo client would use: base URL, model, retry defaults, key present

price.docs: price per question, chains (USDC asset + EIP-712 domain), pay_to, facilitator, credits rules

encode.docs: {state, questions} -> validate offline, return the wire body jevgo would send

noul.docs: {state, instructions, criteria?, model?} -> {noul, model, usage, payment}

score.docs: {state, instructions, levels, model?} -> {score, level, confidence, legend, probabilities, ...}

ask.docs: {state, questions:{name:{kind,instructions,criteria}}, model?, timeout_s?, retry?, headers?, trace?} -> {answers, ...}; priced per question

topup.docs: X-PAYMENT for any amount >= min_topup_usd -> credits for the PAYING address

whoami.docs: who the server thinks you are (token: header -> wallet), whether you pay, your credits

pricing.docs: {pay_to, price_usd, networks, facilitator, enabled, free_local, min_topup_usd} (this box only)

mcp.docs: MCP JSON-RPC at /jev/mcp: jev_noul, jev_choice, jev_score, jev_ask (paid), jev_models, jev_price, jev_balance, jev_encode (free)

paid.how: 402 -> sign accepts[i] (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization, USDC) -> retry with X-PAYMENT; or POST /topup once and send a mod-protocol token
paid.identity: mod-protocol token in `token:` (or Authorization: Bearer): {data,time,key,signature} base64url, EIP-191 personal_sign of {"data":..,"time":..}
paid.gate: Mod().paywall exposes gate_check(fn, headers) for the protocol's own serve: m.serve('jev', paywall=...)

notes.bridge: src/cmd/jevbridge — every network call goes through the Go client; Python never speaks the protocol itself, so the CLI and the library can never disagree with jevgo. Ops: system_one, models, encode (offline validate + wire body), info, version.
notes.questions: System One takes a state plus named questions: noul (probability of yes, optional {true,false} criteria), choice (pick an option, per-option probabilities), score (position against ordered levels, per-level probabilities), raw (pass-through for unknown kinds)
notes.options: every jevgo option is reachable from any call: model, timeout_s, max_retries, retry{max_retries,initial_backoff_ms,max_backoff_ms,jitter,statuses,respect_retry_after,max_retry_after_ms,connection_errors,timeouts,total_timeout_ms}, headers{}, log_level, include_headers, include_raw, trace, extra{}
notes.errors: jevgo sentinels surface as {error, code[, status, message, request_id, retry_after_ms]}: bad_request, authentication, permission_denied, not_found, unprocessable, rate_limit, overloaded, internal, connection, timeout, response_too_large, invalid_response, invalid_request, invalid_config
notes.paying: callers from this box (CLI, loopback with no forwarding header) are the owner and never pay; everyone else pays per question in USDC via x402 or prepaid credits. A failed answer is never charged (verify before, settle after). Replays are refused by nonce.
notes.secrets: The TypeSafe key is read from the environment by the Go binary and never written anywhere in this module. pay_to is public; the ledger is private state under ~/.mod/jev.
